cve.scope: Resolved compile, runtime and test dependencies, including optional devtools.

cwe.additionalScope: Browser upload JavaScript, three Thymeleaf templates, application properties, Dockerfile, Docker Compose, Oracle initialization script, and environment example.

validation: Verified flat CVE array and unique advisory identifiers against retained API responses.
Verified all 59 CWE rule names, descriptions, severity labels and numeric story points against skill definitions.
Verified FOUND evidence paths exist and NOT_FOUND report evidence follows the required empty-files/empty-explanation schema.
Verified all checklist statuses match category report values; checklist NOT_FOUND evidence records scope.
Verified category completion timestamps are sequential.
limitations: Static application-source assessment only; NOT_FOUND is not proof of absence.
Dependency matches establish affected versions, not application-specific exploitability or reachability.
Build plugins, operating-system packages, JVM/native dependency internals, generated code and tests are outside CWE source-review scope.
No tests, application builds, exploit execution, deployment inspection, fixes or commits performed.
Deployed identities, proxy audit logs, file permissions and database isolation were not verified.
No secret values reproduced. Required environment-variable error messages were not misclassified as default passwords.
Assessment artifacts were written directly because write_assessment_result was unavailable; merge workflow was not invoked.
